restless_stone@74.name: Restless Stone
restless_stone@74.text: Once per turn, a Rock monster you control can change its battle position the turn it was Summoned or Set.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do
 -- The core blocks position changes through these statuses, so clear them for your Rock monsters until one
 -- uses the freedom. That spends it for the turn and blocks the others again.
 local used,freed=0x7f34a3,0x7f34a4
 local function marked(c) return c:GetFlagEffect(freed)>0 end
 local function free(e,tp,eg)
  if Duel.GetFlagEffect(0,used)>0 then return end
  for c in eg:Iter() do
   if c:IsControler(0) and c:IsRace(RACE_ROCK) then
    c:SetStatus(STATUS_SUMMON_TURN,false) c:SetStatus(STATUS_SPSUMMON_TURN,false) c:SetStatus(STATUS_FLIP_SUMMON_TURN,false) c:SetStatus(STATUS_FORM_CHANGED,false)
    c:RegisterFlagEffect(freed,RESET_EVENT|RESETS_STANDARD|RESET_PHASE|PHASE_END,0,1)

demonic_pact@77.name: Demonic Pact
demonic_pact@77.text: Recover half the LP cost whenever you pay it for an Archfiend card. If Pandemonium prevents an Archfiend monster’s Standby Phase cost, recover half of the prevented amount.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do
 local standby_costs={}
 local function queue(c,amount,is_standby_monster)
  local refund=math.floor((tonumber(amount) or 0)/2)
  if refund<=0 then return end
  if is_standby_monster and standby_costs[c] then return end
  if is_standby_monster then standby_costs[c]=true end
  Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1800000251) Duel.Recover(0,refund,REASON_EFFECT)
 end
 local paid=Effect.GlobalEffect()
 paid:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS)
 paid:SetCode(EVENT_PAY_LPCOST)
 paid:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp)
  local c=re and re:GetHandler()
  if ep==0 and c and c:IsSetCard(SET_ARCHFIEND) then
   local upkeep=Duel.GetTurnPlayer()==0 and Duel.IsPhase(PHASE_STANDBY) and c:IsMonster()
   queue(c,ev,upkeep)
  end
 end)
 Duel.RegisterEffect(paid,0)
 -- Pandemonium raises this event (its ID + 1; its search uses its ID) from its cost-replacement
 -- operation because replaced upkeep payments do not emit EVENT_PAY_LPCOST.
 local prevented=Effect.GlobalEffect()
 prevented:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS)
 prevented:SetCode(EVENT_CUSTOM+94585853)
 prevented:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp)
  local c=re and re:GetHandler()
  if ep==0 and c and c:IsControler(0) and c:IsMonster() and c:IsSetCard(SET_ARCHFIEND)
   and Duel.GetTurnPlayer()==0 and Duel.IsPhase(PHASE_STANDBY) then queue(c,ev,true) end
 end)
 Duel.RegisterEffect(prevented,0)
 local reset=Effect.GlobalEffect()
 reset:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS)
 reset:SetCode(EVENT_PHASE_START|PHASE_STANDBY)
 reset:SetCondition(function() return Duel.GetTurnPlayer()==0 end)
 reset:SetOperation(function() standby_costs={} end)
 Duel.RegisterEffect(reset,0)
end

lets_go_gambling@89.text: Once per turn, retry a coin toss or dice roll.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do
 local id=0x7f34a1
 local coin=Effect.GlobalEffect() coin:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) coin:SetCode(EVENT_TOSS_COIN_NEGATE)
 coin:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg,ep) return ep==0 and Duel.GetFlagEffect(0,id)==0 end)
 coin:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev) if Duel.GetFlagEffect(0,id)>0 then return end Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1850000225)  Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1860000225) if not Duel.SelectYesNo(0,id) then return end Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1800000225)  Duel.RegisterFlagEffect(0,id,RESET_PHASE|PHASE_END,0,1) Duel.TossCoin(ep,ev) end)
 Duel.RegisterEffect(coin,0)
 local dice=Effect.GlobalEffect() dice:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) dice:SetCode(EVENT_TOSS_DICE_NEGATE)
 dice:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg,ep) return ep==0 and Duel.GetFlagEffect(0,id)==0 end)
 dice:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev) if Duel.GetFlagEffect(0,id)>0 then return end Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1850000225)  Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1860000225) if not Duel.SelectYesNo(0,id) then return end Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1800000225)  Duel.RegisterFlagEffect(0,id,RESET_PHASE|PHASE_END,0,1) Duel.TossDice(ep,ev&0xff,ev>>16) end)
 Duel.RegisterEffect(dice,0)
end
